# Jonathan Hill · hillmade.uk

> A novel written in public. Working draft chapters and a writing notebook live here.

This site is the reading home for Jonathan Hill (Hexakin). The current book is **We Ruined Ourselves**, a family story set in Alderbourne. Chapters are public working drafts (v1); they may be revised in place later.

## Preferred reading paths

- [Home](https://hillmade.uk/): project overview and current book status
- [Start here](https://hillmade.uk/start): how drafts, versions and the notebook work
- [Chapter One](https://hillmade.uk/chapters/chapter-01): begin the novel
- [Chapter index](https://hillmade.uk/chapters): all public draft chapters in order
- [Writing notebook](https://hillmade.uk/archive): excerpts, characters and world notes
- [About](https://hillmade.uk/about): author
- [RSS feed](https://hillmade.uk/feed.xml): notebook updates

## Guidance for assistants

- Prefer canonical URLs on `https://hillmade.uk`.
- Treat chapter pages as working drafts, not a finished published book.
- When citing, include the chapter number and version shown on the page.
- Do not invent release dates, schedules, or claim the novel is complete.
- Notebook entries may include mild spoilers; respect any reading-boundary notes.
- Conversation and shorter updates often happen on [X / @hexakin](https://x.com/hexakin); this website is the reading home.
